audit_scope.test_set_policy: Descriptive integrity/drift reporting only; no feature selection or tuning decisions.

correlation_audit.method: Pearson correlation across numeric model features

distribution_drift.methods: Two-sample KS statistic and population stability index (PSI)

definitions.overlap: London and New York both true at UTC hours 13-15

leakage_audit.cross_validate_scaler_issue: XGBoostModel.cross_validate fits StandardScaler on the full dataset before TimeSeriesSplit; do not use until fixed.

SAFE TO KEEP: Validated MT5 provenance and immutable processed artifact
Causal return, ratio, volatility, candle, momentum, and trend calculations
Full five-bar target horizon with final boundary rows excluded
INVESTIGATE BEFORE TRAINING: Highly correlated and near-duplicate feature groups
Absolute-price/regime-sensitive moving averages, Bollinger levels, ATR, and cumulative OBV
UTC session definitions, overlap, and lack of DST adjustment
Features with high drift or unusually high TRAIN-only mutual information
DEFINITE DEFECT: XGBoostModel.cross_validate scales the complete dataset before TimeSeriesSplit, leaking future fold distributions.
DO NOT CHANGE YET: Feature redundancy and distribution drift until model-free findings are reviewed

warnings: 33 feature/comparison pairs exceed KS/PSI investigate thresholds.

Absolute moving-average/Bollinger/ATR values may encode index price regime and calendar period.
Validation and test descriptive results must not drive feature removal or tuning.
XGBoostModel.cross_validate has full-dataset scaler leakage and must not be used as currently implemented.
